This Order may be cited as the Customs (Agreement on Trade in Goods of the Framework Agreement on Comprehensive Economic Co-operation between the Association of the South-East Asian Nations and the Republic of Korea) Order, 2008 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 1st. January, 2008. Rates of import duties.

Notwithstanding anything contained in the Customs Import Duties Order, 2007 (S 45/07) there shall be levied in respect of the imported goods specified in the Schedule thereto which are shown to the satisfaction of the Controller to have originated from and to have been consigned direct from either the Republic of Korea or from a member country of the Association of South-East Asian Nations, import duties at the rates and in respect of the years specified in the third column of the Schedule. Deemed country of origin of goods.

For the purposes of paragraph 2, goods shall be deemed to have originated from and to have been consigned direct from either the Republic of Korea or from a member country of the Association of South-East Asian Nations where they conform to the Rules of Origin annexed to the Framework Agreement on Comprehensive Economic Co-operation between the Association of South-East Asian Nations and the Republic of Korea. 29th. 2008 SCHEDULE {paragraph 2)
